meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 将 Slack 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用里发送或接收 Slack 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send or receive Slack messages in your app.

howto.what: 这个技能把 Claude 接入 Slack：装好后 Claude 能出现在你的 Slack 频道和私信中，收发消息，并用 Slack 的格式规范回复。它还会帮你配置机器人、密钥和事件接收方式。
howto.when: 在你运行 /setup 设置流程，或使用 /init-first-agent、/manage-channels 给 Claude 接频道时，会用到这个技能。

say.text: 帮我把 Claude 连到 Slack 工作区
say.note: 开始检查和配置 Slack 连接的步骤。

say.text: 设置 Slack 集成，用 Socket 模式
say.note: 会引导你创建 Slack 应用并填写令牌。

say.text: 我要在 Slack 里收到 Claude 的私信
say.note: 会配置私信频道和事件订阅。

howto.what_en: Adds Slack channel integration to Claude. After setup, Claude can send and receive messages in Slack channels, groups, and DMs, formatting replies with Slack's mrkdwn. It copies the Slack adapter, registers it, installs the dependency, validates credentials, and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggered during the setup flow (like /setup) or when using /init-first-agent or /manage-channels to wire channels.

say_en.text: Connect Claude to my Slack workspace.
say_en.note: Starts the Slack integration setup steps.

say_en.text: Set up Slack integration with Socket Mode.
say_en.note: Guides you through creating the app and pasting tokens.

say_en.text: I want to receive DMs from Claude in Slack.
say_en.note: Configures the DM channel and event subscriptions.
